_readme: The ten tasks the decision layer (assets/decide.mjs, scripts/derive-task-fit.mjs) scores models against. Each task's fit score is computed on data/models.json's existing fields — see scripts/derive-task-fit.mjs's header for exactly which fields feed which task and why. A task with no basis for a given model gets score: null on that model, never a guess.

tasks.label: Coding
tasks.description: Writing, reading, or fixing code in a single file or a small, scoped change.

tasks.label: Agents / multi-step work
tasks.description: Long autonomous runs — multi-file edits, tool calls, and plans that carry across many steps without a human in the loop.

tasks.label: Bulk / high-volume
tasks.description: The same small task run thousands of times a day, where cost per call matters as much as getting it right.

tasks.label: Writing
tasks.description: Prose: drafts, emails, marketing copy, long-form content.

tasks.label: Research / analysis
tasks.description: A hard question or a pile of source material that needs real reasoning, not a lookup.

tasks.label: Extraction / classification
tasks.description: Pulling structured fields or labels out of text, usually at volume.

tasks.label: Chat / assistant
tasks.description: General back-and-forth conversation — no heavy coding or multi-step reasoning.

tasks.label: Vision
tasks.description: Understanding images, screenshots, or documents that carry visual information, not just text.

tasks.label: Frontend / UI code
tasks.description: Building or editing the parts of an app a person actually looks at and clicks.

tasks.label: Executive summaries
tasks.description: Condensing long material into a short, readable brief for a reader who won't read the source.
